what: While the long section is pinned, as scroll progresses 1650 dots (phone 900) light up layer by layer from the inside out to form a cloud. Each dot has its own turn-on share (.035~.6) and grows (.72 → 1.18x) as it appears between that share −.035 and +.075, and the first 26 are seeds that are lit from the start. The cloud diameter grows .68 → .88x over progress .035~.665, and the color warms from gray to a light accent tone over progress .08~.52. Each dot sways radially as if breathing (.92·.61 Hz phases) and the whole cloud rotates very slowly by ±2°. After progress .78 the dots vanish from the right and the cloud shifts slightly left. Progress follows slowly with a per-second exponent of .0008^dt (WebGL, additive blending)

options.x: Cloud center horizontal position (multiple of half the screen width, 1024px and up only), default -.31 — 0 means centered
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on (required) — sized to the screen inside a fixed stage

from.where: index.html .a-stack — dot cloud that lights up on a pinned screen, four sentences in the right section change with --fx-progress

note: To tie section text to the same progress, read the element’s --fx-progress (0~1) or the fx:progress event (detail.progress)
